title: Claude-account quota document. One JSON document an external publisher (J-05 quota-pull) writes atomically to <data>/quota.json; derived data, never in the journal, so an older board that knows no quota route can replay this journal and start (rollback is safe). The page reads it as-is from GET /api/v1/quota and never recomputes it.
description: Every time is an ISO timestamp. window5h / week are the account-wide Claude Code rate_limits as last seen (pct 0-100); a window that has no value (the plan sends none, or the collector never saw it) is null or left out, never written as 0. A window whose resets_at is already behind is NOT rewritten by the publisher: it sends the last merged value and the page shows it as reset / unknown. Whether a window is live, stale or already reset is decided by the page from as_of and resets_at against the clock. tokens count this machine's Claude Code only. Fields this schema does not name are allowed (a newer publisher may add some) and ignored.

generated_at.description: When the publisher built this document.

pct.description: Share of the window used when it was last seen.

resets_at.description: When the window resets; left out when the plan payload carried none (the page then cannot call the window passed).

as_of.description: When this pct was first reported (the date of the value; a later re-render of the same or an older value does not move it).

seen_at.description: Newest real snapshot of this window: the freshness signal the page judges live / stale by. Left out (older publisher, or a fallback source that cannot prove freshness) = as_of decides.

today.description: Input + output + cache-write tokens since local midnight.

d7.description: The same over the last 7 days.

last_activity.description: Last Claude Code use seen on the machine (shown when today is 0).

since.description: Since when the machine has been unreachable (else checked_at is shown).

label.description: Account name shown on the card, e.g. Premium A.

machine.description: Free text under the name, e.g. Main PC · this machine.

tokens.description: null or left out = this machine could not be counted (unreachable, or its Claude Code transcripts folder is missing): unknown, never 0.

snap.description: never_seen = the collector has never written a rate_limits snapshot on this machine (not installed). fallback = the windows come from a last-payload dump that any session overwrites, so they may be older or lower than the truth: shown as unverified, never live. Left out = not stated.

warnings.description: Short collector notes the owner should see, e.g. the transcripts folder is missing.
